name: humid_air_1691_cycling_on_released_after_dry
description: After a humid refusal of the cycling-on, the outdoor air dries and the next cycling check switches the fan back on
notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: a cycling guard that never released (e.g. a sticky refusal) leaves 12:30 reading nat_vent_humid_skip. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the fan would stay off for the rest of the evening although the air outside dried.
Issue #1507 review: the classification no longer hand-sets windows_recommended; classifier.py derives it for this mild day (True), as production would.

Issue #1507 review: the outdoor humidity is paired with a dedicated outdoor temperature sensor (outdoor_temp_source sensor), as a real install needs for an outdoor dew point, so the coordinator-hosted golden tiers (P8 surfaces, promise parity, real HA) can run this scenario.
